capabilities.title: Marketing automation: email campaigns, lead scoring, nurture workflows, A/B tests
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Mautic: open-source HubSpot alternative with full marketing automation
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a marketing automation platform. Mautic's CRM, tracking, messaging, integration, scheduling, and campaign-execution runtime remain outside scope.

capabilities.title: Visual campaign workflow builder: drag-drop multi-step automation canvas
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Official Mautic documentation describes a drag-and-drop Campaign Builder canvas with sources, events, actions, decisions, conditions, cloning, and explicit triggering.
capabilities.notes: Nexus completes its own local linear workflow editor: built-in campaign draft, safe default merging, node edit/add/duplicate/remove, drag and keyboard ordering, deterministic edges, save/clone/export, server validation, dirty-state run gating, and human approval. CRM/contact branching and external execution are deliberately not part of this product-native capability.

capabilities.title: Contact segmentation: filter and tag contacts by behavior and attributes
capabilities.reason: Nexus has no CRM or contact management. Behavioral grouping, profiling, tracking, and contact segmentation remain outside scope.

capabilities.title: PHP/Symfony architecture for a large web application
capabilities.sourceEvidence: The current Composer workspace is a PHP project built from Mautic packages and Symfony components.
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a TypeScript/Next.js app; PHP/Symfony infrastructure and the GPL runtime are not applicable and are not copied.
